data.headline: Create Like Zaytoven on Splice
data.description: Zaytoven shares how Splice loops and samples help him create unique sounds.
data.transcript: I'm almost like an old man at heart. I don't know why, I've been like this since I was young, even with producing. I still like making beats the old way, but I love when something new or some new piece of technology, some new equipment comes out, because right now I can use that and add to what I do and make, you know, it'll make me that much bigger, better. This right here helps me expand and think outside of what I would've done. Yeah, like that string line right there. That's all.

data.transcript: This has got to be one of the most widely used samples in all of music from the last decade. Let's see if you can recognize it... So this is that original sample, it's that whistle you hear in the background with all those melodies. And this man, the myth and legend himself, KSHMR: musician, DJ, producer. He was responsible for creating that whistle melody you guys just heard. I first heard about KSHMR when he produced Like a G6 for Far East Movement. Such an iconic time! And this is the Splice pack that it came from. It had over 1465 samples when it dropped, one of the most iconic sample packs of all time. Some of these sounds have been used in the biggest songs in the world. If you're a Splice user, Sounds of KSHMR Volume 5 just dropped. Thousands and thousands of new one-shots, transitions, effects, melodies, drums, loops, just all kinds of stuff to unpack. And by the way, while you're at it, you might as well go cop that Bay To LA Volume 2, just dropped on Splice. I got a $500 beat challenge for all my producers. Just get the pack on Splice, cook up your hottest beat, post it, tag me by March 27th. Easy money.
